summary: The study investigates the atomic layer epitaxy (ALE) growth of CdTe on GaAs (100) substrates using in-situ spectroscopic ellipsometry (SE). The process involves alternating exposures to Cd and Te precursors, with flushing periods to remove excess precursors. The growth occurs at temperatures between 300–325 °C, and the study highlights the role of surface reactions and desorption mechanisms in the ALE process. The in-situ SE monitoring confirms the monolayer-by-monolayer growth and provides insights into the process window and growth dynamics.
